core: Multi-lane (7x64-bit) striped multiply-rotate accumulation over 56-byte blocks with an overlapping final block, length folding, and an xxHash/murmur-style xor-shift-multiply finalizer — i.e. the known xxHash design.

Seven parallel 64-bit lanes absorbing 56-byte stripes by add-then-rotate with distinct fixed per-lane rotation amounts (no multiply/xor in the absorb loop), then a six-node rotate-add tree fold and a length-salted moremur multiply-xor-shift finalizer.

xxHash-style striped hashing: seven parallel accumulator lanes with distinct odd multipliers and per-lane rotate-multiply over 56-byte blocks, folded into one accumulator, 8/4/1-byte tail, then Murmur3 fmix64 avalanche finalizer.

Seven parallel 64-bit accumulators, each fed deliberately overlapping unaligned 8-byte loads (7-byte offsets, 49-byte stride over 50 read bytes) through a per-lane xor-rotate-add-constant ARX round, round-robined over the tail, folded by rotated addition with the length, and finished with the stock splitmix64/Stafford Mix13 avalanche finalizer.

Rotate-xor-add streaming hash whose main loop chains every 8-byte word into one shared additive accumulator W and feeds W (not the raw word) into seven rotation-distinct lane accumulators, then folds lanes + W and applies a splitmix64/Stafford-mix13 finaliser with a length tweak.

Wide 1024-bit (16x64) ARX state hash: each 128-byte block is added into all 16 lanes followed by exactly one invertible add-rotate shear round (intentionally incomplete per-block diffusion), with length prefix and 0x01 padding, then 12 held finishing rounds, a six-term rotate-add fold to 64 bits, and Murmur3 fmix64 as the final avalanche; AVX2 and scalar paths plus a 4-lane short-input variant.

Six-lane rotate/xor ring accumulator fed by a 256-entry byte table whose entries are (b|0x100) shifted left by 6*popcount(b), then a linear/nonlinear lane fold and a standard SplitMix64/Murmur3 fmix64 multiply-xor-shift finalizer.

A 6-lane SipHash-style ARX sponge (per-lane add-rotate, fixed cross-lane XOR diffusion, length-padded 48-byte blocks, 3–4 finalization rounds, 384→64 fold), where the only native-derived twist is that each round's rotation amounts are offset by a running popcount accumulator (`cup`) of the input words.

SipHash-style ARX (add-rotate-xor) permutation over a four-word state with four interleaved lanes for long inputs and fixed finalization rounds, decorated by a data-dependent rotate-by-popcount on each absorbed 64-bit word; no multiplication.

Multiplication-free six-lane ARX hash: each 8-byte word is added to its lane together with a cross-lane feedback word, then rotated left by (2*popcount(word) + per-lane constant), with lanes folded and passed through a Wang-style shift-add/xor finalizer.

Multiply-free absorption loop: XOR each byte/32-byte block into the state, then rotate by a data-derived distance (the mark's own low bits + a fixed offset, per-lane via AVX2 variable shifts) with a second data-selected rotation and cross-lane permute coupling, closed by an O(1) splitmix64 finalizer.

Per-byte data-dependent rotation: state ^= byte then rotate-left by (popcount(byte)+1), across six cross-fed accumulator lanes, with length folded in and a standard MurmurHash3 fmix64 xor-shift-multiply finalizer.

xxHash3-style striped SIMD multiply-accumulate (64-byte stripes into 8 secret-anchored lanes, lo32*hi32 products plus cross-lane data adds), with a small 4-word serial rolling state broadcast as a per-stripe modulation of the lane keys, finished by pairwise 64x64->128 folds and a two-round multiply-xor-shift avalanche.

Three ring-chained lane accumulators (CRC32 shift-register or ARX fallback) whose per-pass combined 'angle' drives data-dependent-rotate/add/xor updates of three separate constant-seeded secondary accumulators, with a single wymix-style 128-bit multiply-fold finalizer over the combined wires, lanes and length.

Multiply-free ARX core loop over 64-byte stripes: 8 keyed lanes each doing xor-with-data, rotate by a lane-specific constant, then add the previous pass's neighbouring lane (circulant lane-to-lane carry), with the only multiplications in a one-shot mul128-fold merge plus fmix64 finalizer (xxh3-style framing: keyed secret, overlapping last stripe, short-input path).

Multiply-free ARX streaming hash: eight fixed parallel 64-bit lanes each updated by acc = rotl(acc ^ word, 29) + word over 64-byte blocks (AVX2-vectorised), then a one-shot length-seeded multiply-xor tree fold plus murmur3-style fmix64 finalizer.

Multiplication-free 4-stage systolic rotate-XOR pipeline absorbing 64-bit words (each stage XORs its upstream neighbour's previous-pass state into its own rotation), with the last stage's state added into four rotation-offset accumulators (SIMD-vectorised) every pass, then six fixed-constant drain passes and a single splitmix64 fmix64 finalisation of the four accumulators plus length.

Multiplication-free LFSR/CRC-style state grinding (hardware _mm_crc32_u64, else a bidirectional xorshift round) folding 64-bit words into eight parallel anchored 32-bit accumulators, followed by a cross-lane carry chain and a wide-multiply + murmur3-style avalanche finalizer.

xxHash3-style wide 8x64 striped accumulate (data ^= key; acc[i^1] += data; acc[i] += lo32*hi32) with AVX2 vectorization, a counter-stepped key sequence instead of a fixed secret, overlapping-read short-input paths, and an rrmxmx 64-bit finalizer.

A near-verbatim xxHash3 (XXH3_64) clone: 8-lane accumulator absorbing 64-byte stripes with secret-XORed 32x32->64 multiply-add plus xxh3's own adjacent-lane `acc[j^1] += v` swap-add, periodic bijective scramble (xor-shift 47, secret xor, PRIME32_1 multiply) here extended with a 3-lane rotation so the pair-coupling graph becomes a connected 8-cycle, then 128-bit multiply-folds of the lanes into a length-seeded xor-shift-multiply finalizer, with a separate short-input multiply-fold path.

Wide 8x64-bit ARX state absorbing 64-byte blocks: add message words plus per-block-incrementing lane constants, then a cross-lane permute/rotate/xor-add butterfly so each lane diffuses into all others; blank-input finalization rounds, then an irreversible 512->64 fold through MurmurHash3 fmix64 (the only multiplies).

Sponge-style absorption of 64-byte blocks into a 512-bit eight-lane state via one cross-coupled ARX (Feistel-like add/rotate/xor + lane re-pairing) round per block with a per-block counter, then 16 fixed finalization rounds and a per-lane bit-fold to one byte each for the 64-bit output; only the len<64 path falls back to FNV/xxHash-style multiply-xor-shift on a single accumulator.

8-lane simple tabulation (Zobrist) hashing: each byte indexes a position-rotated 256-entry random table and is accumulated by addition into one of 8 independent lanes with per-lane rotations, then lanes are combined and run through a Murmur3 fmix64 finalizer (bytes are never multiplied in the kernel, unlike FNV-1a/xxHash).

Multiply-free 8-lane absorb loop (xor with a counter-derived per-block key, rotate-xor-add) with explicit cross-lane coupling each block — scalar `v[(j+1)&7] += rotl(v[j],13)`, AVX2 `A+=B; B^=A; permute4x64` — over persistent state, finalized once by a 128-bit multiply fold (mum) chain plus splitmix64.

xxHash64 verbatim: four independent 64-bit striped accumulator lanes running the standard add-multiply-rotl-multiply round over 32-byte blocks, merged by rotl(1,7,12,18) plus mergeRound, length added, 8/4/1-byte tail folds, then a murmur-style xor-shift/multiply avalanche finalizer — i.e. the known multiply-xor-rotate accumulator fold, with the four 'birds' reduced to lane seeds/constants and no consensus test or refold-until-agreement anywhere.

xxHash/XXH3-style multi-lane block hashing: four parallel 64-bit accumulators absorbing 32-byte blocks via (word^counter-advanced key) 32x32->64 multiply plus lane-rotated adds (AVX2 or scalar), then xxHash64 mergeRound combination and MurmurHash3 fmix64 finalization, with a widened FNV-1a path for short inputs.

xxHash64: four 64-bit accumulator lanes consuming 32-byte stripes with add-multiply/rotate/multiply rounds, rotate-and-sum lane merge plus per-lane mergeAccumulator, length injection, 8/4/1-byte tail folding, and an xor-shift/multiply final avalanche.

Multi-lane (4- or 8-way) streaming absorption where each 8-byte word is mixed by add-then-data-dependent-variable-rotate (rotate amount = low 6 bits of state XOR word), followed by two fixed-rotate cross-lane XOR diffusion rounds and a Murmur3-style multiply-shift finalizer.

SipHash-2-4: four-word 64-bit ARX (add-rotate-xor) state with each message word xored in, carried through two SipRounds, xored out, then length-tagged and finalized by four rounds into one xor-folded word — with an AVX2 4-lane parallel SipHash tree (one lane per 32-byte-dealt stripe) for inputs >=256 bytes whose four lane results plus tail are re-hashed by the same serial function.

Four-lane (AVX2 / scalar) NH-style 32x32→64 multiply-accumulate over 32-byte blocks, augmented with a cross-lane XOR-difference (lane j vs lane j+1) that drives a variable-rotation companion state, with lanes cross-combined and avalanche-finalized.

xxHash3-style 4-lane SIMD/scalar accumulator (lo32×hi32 widening products plus lane-swapped data adds) in which each input word is first XORed with a lagged, cross-lane-rotated copy of the accumulator ('callus') before multiplication, finished by mul128 xor-folding of the lanes plus length and a Murmur3 fmix64 finalizer, with a separate serial multiply-fold path for len<64.

xxHash64-style hashing: four parallel 64-bit accumulator lanes fed by rotate-xor-input-times-odd-constant rounds over 32-byte blocks, lane merge by rotl(1/7/12/18)+add, tail folding, length injection, and MurmurHash3 fmix64 finalisation.

xxHash64: 8-lane (4-lane-style) striped multiply-rotate-add accumulators over 64-byte blocks, merge-round collapse, length injection, 8/4/1-byte tail folding, and an xor-shift/multiply final avalanche — i.e. the known multiply-xor-shift accumulator approach plus generic loop-unrolling/ILP striping, which actually breaks the native's single serial never-lifted chain into eight independent ones.

Bijective ARX block round over a 256-bit four-lane accumulator — data words added into the already-rotated lane state (ROTL(v+w,16)), then pairwise add/rotate-xor plus cross-lane feedback, with no multiplication on data, giving invertible, order-dependent, non-converging diffusion; xxHash64's lane merge, tail and final avalanche are reused only as the output stage.

Sponge-style absorb of 32-byte blocks XORed into a single 256-bit ARX state (add + cross-lane permute/shuffle + rotate, deliberately one serial chain rather than independent lanes), four blind permutation rounds, then truncation to 64 bits through a Murmur-style fmix finaliser.

A sponge-style ARX hash: 384-bit state split into a 256-bit rate (a0..a3, the only words message blocks are added into) and a 128-bit capacity (c0,c1, never touched by input, mixed only by TIP), absorbed block-by-block through SipRound permutations with constant IVs plus length, finalised by extra TIP/TURN rounds and truncated to a single 64-bit XOR of the state — not FNV/xxHash multiply-xor-shift accumulation.

Streaming multi-lane (4x64) ARX accumulator hash: XOR 32-byte blocks into one carried state, apply a fixed invertible shift-add/xorshift/rotate-add round per block (plus AVX2 wide variant and overlapping tail read), then SipRound-style finalization and a multiply-free xorshift/rotate avalanche — i.e., xxHash/SipHash-shaped single-accumulator folding with shift-add substituted for the multiply.

Simple tabulation (Zobrist) hashing: 8x256 precomputed 64-bit tables XOR-folded into one accumulator with a fixed rotation per step (the per-byte ARC=29 rotation algebraically folded into the tables so a full 8-byte turn is one ROTL 40), multiply-free, with a table-driven rotate-xor finalizer over the accumulator's own bytes.

Off-the-shelf SipHash-1-3-style ARX accumulator (4x64-bit state, fixed rounds per 8-byte word, length-padded tail, 4 finalisation rounds, XOR-folded output) with a generic AVX2 4-lane shift/or/add block path as a speed optimisation.

Multiply-free ARX streaming hash: each 8-byte word is added into a lane accumulator then passed through a fixed count (two) of compile-time rotate-xor bijections x ^= rotl(x,a) ^ rotl(x,b), over 4 scalar (or 8 AVX2) independent lanes, finished with 4 SipRounds and an XOR fold.

Multi-lane ARX streaming hash: per-8-byte-lane xor + add-rotl(29) + xor-rotl(47) over 32-byte (or AVX2 64-byte) blocks with an overlapping tail block, folded into four seeded words and finalised by SpookyHash's 12-step ShortEnd rotate/xor/add chain, returning one state word.

SipHash-style ARX (add-rotate-xor) sponge-like compression: 256-bit four-word state, little-endian 8-byte blocks xored in with exactly one SipRound per block plus length byte and three finalisation rounds, folded by xor into a 64-bit output — multiplication-free, i.e. not the FNV/xxHash multiply-xor-shift route.

ChaCha-style ARX block permutation (add/xor/rotl-16,12,8,7 quarter-rounds over 8 parallel 4-word lanes with diagonal lane re-spins) absorbing 128-byte blocks into a non-commutative 64-bit chaining accumulator, finished with a murmur3 fmix64 avalanche; multiplication-free in the hot loop rather than xxHash/FNV multiply-xor-shift.

16×64-bit state held as 4 parallel lanes absorbing 32-byte stripes with a SipRound-style ARX permutation (add/rotate/xor) per lane plus a per-stripe cross-lane rotational shuffle for diffusion, then 3 blank rounds, a 4×4 diagonal XOR fold with length injection, and a double murmur3 fmix64 finalizer (with an XXH3-style overlapping-read path for len<32 and the tail).

ChaCha-style ARX permutation (add-rotate-xor quarter-rounds, column then diagonal rounds) over a 16x64-bit state absorbing XOR-ed 128-byte blocks with a block counter, plus splitmix64 finalization and overlapping-tail/short-input regimes, AVX2-vectorized.

Multiply-free 8-lane ARX absorption of 64-byte blocks (v[i] = rotl(v[i]^w, per-lane odd rotation) + (w ^ pi-derived key), scalar and AVX2-identical), then O(1) cross-lane ARX 'square' diffusion rounds, length injection, binary tree fold, and a splitmix/Murmur3 64-bit finalizer.

Wide ARX permutation sponge: input blocks XOR-absorbed into a 4x4 (twin 4x4 under AVX2) 64-bit state, mixed by BLAKE2b-G add/xor/rotate rounds applied to columns then lane-rotated (diagonal) orientations, with extra finalization rounds and a Murmur3 fmix64 fold to 64 bits.

Eight-lane (512-bit) ARX sponge: per-lane xor-rotate-add absorption of 64-byte blocks with distinct per-lane rotation constants, odd lane keys and a block counter, interleaved with hypercube-butterfly quarter-rounds (d=1,2,4) for cross-lane diffusion, finished by a lossy 8-lane collapse plus MurmurHash3 fmix64 — multiplies appear only in the finalizer, not in the mixing core (inputs under 128 bytes take a separate single-accumulator rotate-xor-add path).

Verbatim xxHash64: four parallel 64-bit lanes of rotate-multiply accumulation over 32-byte stripes, lane merge, length injection and 8/4/1-byte tail folding, closed by a Murmur3/SplitMix-style xor-shift-multiply finaliser extended to seven stages (length-gated to three for short inputs).

wyhash/xxHash-style buffer folding: 128-bit widening multiply folded by hi^lo (mum) over four parallel accumulator lanes for >=64-byte blocks, a 16-byte single-accumulator chained loop, overlapping-read tail, length injection, and a Murmur3 fmix64 finalizer extended by two extra multiply-xorshift steps.

Chained CRC-32C accumulation (SSE4.2 _mm_crc32_u64 / ARM __crc32cd, with a reflected 0x82F63B78 table fallback) over 8/32-byte blocks, cross-fed with a parallel rotate-add 64-bit accumulator and length-seeded init, closed by a MurmurHash3-style xor-shift/multiply fmix finalizer.

Per-byte sequential accumulator fold — acc = rotl23(acc + (byte ^ odd_const)) with a length-seeded initial state — followed by a 7-stage xor-shift/odd-multiply (SplitMix/Murmur-style) finalizer; no multiply in the hot chain, and the flip-one-bit avalanche check is described but not implemented in code.

Multiply-free serial 64-bit accumulator over 8-byte words where each step is rot(cup^word, cup&63) + odd constant (data/state-dependent rotation chaining), finished by a 7-round rotate / shift-add / xor-shift avalanche finalizer keyed with the length, with a constructor-time bit-flip avalanche self-test that falls back to FNV-1a only if the self-test fails.

xxHash-style hashing: eight parallel rotate-xor-multiply accumulator lanes over 64-byte blocks, position-weighted lane merge plus length injection, finalized by a splitmix64 xor-shift/multiply finalizer extended to seven steps.
